chunks: And all those who are on the earth, to save himself.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God saves someone from all those on earth?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Ma'arij, this verse underscores the concept of divine preservation (inayah) amidst the general decay of creation, a theme particularly resonant in Shia theology regarding the protection of the Imams and the faithful from corruption. It reflects the belief that while the masses may be lost in heedlessness, God’s chosen servants are safeguarded by His specific will and power. This preservation is not merely physical but spiritual, ensuring their ultimate success in the Hereafter.
